title: Placed Consumer Accounts Return Service Times: Bankruptcy, Deceased Notices and Client Recalls
content:
Account Closure desk schedule for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. It fixes, per placement stage, the business days within which an account is returned to the client after a bankruptcy notice, after a deceased notice, and for a client recall or a confirmed identity-theft return.

| Stage | Return after a bankruptcy notice (business days after the notice) | Return after a deceased notice (business days after the notice) | Client recall or confirmed identity-theft return processed within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Primary Placement | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Secondary Placement | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Tertiary Placement | 2 | 3 | 3 |
| Warehouse Placement | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Legal Review Placement | 1 | 2 | 2 |

## Definitions

- **Bankruptcy return time**: the business days after a bankruptcy notice within which the account is returned to the client.
- **Deceased return time**: the business days after a deceased notice within which the account is returned to the client.
- **Recall processing time**: the business days within which a client recall or a confirmed identity-theft return is processed.

## Reading the schedule

- Early-Out Placement and Legal Review Placement have the shortest times in every column; Warehouse Placement has the longest.
- At every stage the deceased return time and the recall processing time are equal, and the bankruptcy return time is shorter than both.
